description: Return click analytics for one short link by ID from list_links or search_links: total clicks, clicks by day, and top referrers, countries and devices for a date range.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

id.description: Link ID from list_links or search_links.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: get_link_analytics

outputSchema.description: Clicks are deduplicated link visits in UTC days of range. clicksByDay omits days without clicks and holds at most the latest 90; clicksByDayTruncated marks a cut series. topReferrers, topCountries and topDevices hold the 10 largest sources by clicks.

title: Get link analytics
